premises.text: Unbanked populations without credit cannot pay online the usual credit way in high-inflation countries
premises.evidence_span: impossible to do it in the most common way to do a payment online, which is on credit

premises.evidence_span: our users can pay online on installments in local currency

premises.text: Facebook signup plus ID selfie KYC feeds ML scoring with social, external, and fraud checks

premises.text: ML plus external default checks and fraud prevention produce a credit score used to approve credit

premises.text: Payment flow converts to pesos and presents installment choices with interest disclosure
